verdict_label: Seen as a gesture for animals
explanation: Beckoning with a single raised finger is seen across much of the Arab world, including the UAE, as a gesture used to call animals or servants, which makes it demeaning when directed at a person. The accepted alternative is to turn your palm face-down and make a gentle scooping motion with your fingers toward yourself.
local_tip: To call someone over, turn your palm face-down and wave your fingers toward yourself rather than curling one finger upward.

also_check.note: The same upright-finger beckon is used only for animals and is considered very rude directed at a person.
A single raised finger to beckon is seen as crude; a palm-down wave is the polite alternative.
The gesture isn't taboo but can come across as condescending in a formal setting.

sources.title: Traditional Gestures Around The World That Mean The Opposite In The US
